_about: J/22 points that have no socket, measured on the hero hull (Inputs/j22-hero/fbx/SM_J22H_Hull.fbx) in Blender metres (X forward, Y port, Z up). ChainplateMid_S is the hero's one chainplate a side (both shrouds), abeam of the mast since boat kit phase 2; its x is a GUESS, so as a solve point it pins the camera to the model rather than measuring the plate.
